description: This is a Python source file implementing a configuration class for OpenAI video generation within a larger ML/AI project. It defines methods for constructing requests, transforming responses, and managing API interactions specific to OpenAI video APIs, extending a base video configuration class.

classes.name: OpenAIVideoConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI video generation, extending BaseVideoConfig and providing methods for request transformation, response handling, and environment validation specific to OpenAI's API.

methods.description: Maps optional parameters for OpenAI video creation, currently returning the input parameters unchanged.

methods.description: Transforms the raw response from OpenAI into a VideoObject, encoding ID if needed, and including usage statistics.
